full_model_bundle_policy: A full-model result requires same-seed G/R_psi/B_phi/S_omega checkpoints and exact dependency hashes. Historical Phase 29 downstream seeds over fixed GlobalMedFiLM seed 42 are not independent end-to-end C3 cells.

selection_policy.tie_break: lower validation loss, then earlier epoch
selection_policy.full_model_selection: select only among compatible same-seed full bundles; never use GlobalMedFiLM-only outputs as FULL scores

hd95.unit: pixels; no physical spacing is assumed
hd95.method: symmetric 95th percentile surface distance with the repository's 8-connected boundary implementation
hd95.empty_or_undefined: null per-image value with a nonempty undefined_reason; per-domain mean includes only defined cases and reports n_defined
hd95.empty_mask_convention: both-empty, empty-prediction, and empty-ground-truth cases are explicitly undefined under the existing metric helper; identical for FULL and all baselines

metric_policy.paired_roster: identical VAL sample IDs, domain labels, task IDs and denominators per matched seed

cost_policy.parameter_count: sum distinct learned component parameters; shared checkpoints counted once
cost_policy.analytical_compute: component/path-specific MAC accounting; conditional route paths reported separately
cost_policy.latency: measured separately with device, software, batch size, warm-up and repetition counts
cost_policy.unsupported_comparisons: no lower-cost claim without compatible end-to-end measurements

secondary_evaluations.component_ablation: Existing A1-A8 evidence is in-sample; only A7-vs-A8 is the prespecified one-factor safety contrast.
secondary_evaluations.router_budget_sensitivity: pending separate non-primary analysis; do not retune on ROUTER_HOLDOUT or external cohorts
secondary_evaluations.safety_harm_benefit: retain all-case and conditional denominators; segmentation harm is not clinical safety
secondary_evaluations.domain_shift_external_stress: report existing 884-case retrospective cohort separately; no rerun
secondary_evaluations.corruption_robustness: pending a frozen corruption protocol; no execution
secondary_evaluations.accuracy_compute_tradeoff: pending matched full-system and baseline measurements

internal_ablation_hierarchy.P1: Learned-FiLM GlobalMedFiLM without BARR; internal reference
internal_ablation_hierarchy.P2: P1 plus always-on regional refinement; A1 descriptive in-sample endpoint
internal_ablation_hierarchy.P3: P1 plus router/refiner without post-safety; A6/A7 descriptive; not a controlled P2 progression
internal_ablation_hierarchy.P4: RA-MedFiLM-BARR (FULL); A8; A7-vs-A8 isolates S_omega only

historical_results_policy: Keep historical protocol-incomparable C3 results in a separate section. GlobalMedFiLM remains an internal ablation reference and must never fill a full-model result cell.
